name: R036-roar-after-ghost-curse-evasion
why: The opponent's Dusclops (set 666, Ghost) can put its Curse on the player's Granbull (set 376; Normal, so Shadow Ball cannot touch it and Curse is a good pick). Granbull uses Roar every turn (priority -6, always last), which sends in a random other opponent Pokemon. Both others have an evasion move: Muk (420, Minimize) and Claydol (524, Double Team). On the next turn the AI scores that move against the cursed Granbull and draws the cursed-target roll (AI_CV_EvasionUp). Granbull keeps the curse as long as it stays in.
